answer.draftNote: DRAFT: one model's reading of each pool. Review before use.
answer.strongOnlyNote: Only strong proposals enter a draft. That does not say a strong one is right. The others are in the report.
answer.partialNote: Not every field was judged. status, stopReasonName and each row's notJudgedReason say why. notJudged, lostAtRestart and judgeRefused are not the judge declining.
answer.fieldLineNote: First member: the name as sent. Then each hub: its category, the hub element's own identifier in brackets (CEDS [cedsId P002040]; or, by name, why it has none), then the card's label when it fits.
